page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With an 8.0 GB per core memory allocation, the ecs.hfr9i.3xlarge is positioned as a memory-optimized instance. This resource density makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources without the overhead of local storage. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
